horoscopes.horoscope: Your sportsman spirit will find its way into both your professional and personal life. Today may be an important day in your life, and Ganesha says you must not forget your special quality. You will leave your partner ecstatic with the intensity of your love. Your sweetheart will be on cloud nine for your caring and affectionate nature. You will be able to please him/her emotionally. Tonight you are ready to stimulate your lover and passionate love making is on the cards. You will have high energy today. However, you need to keep your ‘fire’ under check. You also need to control anger/aggression, stay composed and convert your energy into something positive by channelizing it. Also, avoid consuming spicy food as it could disturb your stomach. You will be happy to help others and you will not mind helping them financially too. Ganesha suggests you to be sure of financial returns of investments done today. It is better to be calculative then ignorant. Bravo! Your presence of mind will be brilliant today, says Ganesha. Your talent, skill, intelligence will fetch quick progress and will be highly appreciated. Ganesha feels that your brilliance will give a considerable push to your career. It will give you the mental satisfaction.

You will put your heart and soul into whatever you do today, says Ganesha. But there may still be dark clouds hovering over the results. Don’t let that bother you. You must keep up the hard work throughout the day. Finally, you will hit the deck with a feeling of happiness and satisfaction, predicts Ganesha. Love life, on the other hand, will blossom. You will want to spend as much time as possible with your beloved. You need to stay attached to your sweetheart even though your daily work seems to be more important today, suggests Ganesha. Even though you do not face any major health issue today you will have to be careful about your confidence. You should depend on your own abilities and avoid seeking moral or emotional support from others as there are chances of disappointment. Ganesha advises you to be extra careful and calculative before taking any financial decision that’s related to commodity or stock market. Gambling must be avoided, else it will turn out to be a bitter experience. Only routine stuff will occupy your mind today. You will be ready to simplify your assignments. Avoid anything that requires more than a casual attention. Try to stay away from complex projects as stars reveal that it would be difficult for you to pay attention to quality.

Today, your emotions will cloud your ability to reason. You may try to find a refuge in devotional and spiritual activities. A visit to a couple of religious places may help you restore your peace of mind. A laid-back mindset will work wonders for you today. You want your freedom today more than anything else. You want to stay detached from your lover Even when your partner comes to you, you are thinking he/she wants to be possessive. Traveling with your sweetheart is on the cards, says Ganesha. Ganesha observes that you shall remain in the pink of health today. Hence, you should apply your mind to tackle tricky people, and utilise your energy to do physically demanding tasks. Also devise a health plan and exercise regularly. Today is going to be an average day for you on the financial front. On this dull day, Ganesha advises you no to take any major monetary decisions, as they are not likely to bear fruit. Today, your creative juices will be overflowing and will add a new dimension to even your routine work. Your creative ideas may fetch appreciation if effectively implemented. You are likely to influence your peers in the meeting or discussion, says Ganesha.

Today is a fabulous day for your love life. Your happiness may make a few people go green with envy, but they can do you or your relationship no harm, so ignore them. However, it may be important for you to make sure that you safeguard your reputation. On the personal front, Ganesha feels that things will take a positive turn and any harsh feelings between you and your beloved will be sorted out. Your self-confidence will be back and you will build a more meaningful relationship. You will feel relaxed and contented in the evening. As far as your physical fitness is concerned, there is hardly anything to worry. However, you may become very emotional today. Hence, Ganesha advises you to control yourself and think practically. To divert your mind – simply do something different and interesting. Today you are likely to have some good financial gains, Ganesha foresees. Your financial strength will be good as the whole cosmos is conspiring in your favour. Your frank and crisp language may help you express better at the workplace. Ganesha, however, suggests that you need to be more articulate while talking to your colleagues and seniors as blunt words may hurt the ego of people and your valuable inputs may get rejected. Avoid imposing your thoughts onto others.

Even an emperor, when struck with an ailment, is not a pretty sight. Bearing this in mind, today you shall make health your number one priority, says Ganesha. You will do wise to chart out some sort of a workout regime for yourself, and inculcate a sense of discipline in maintaining it, even if it is anything as simple as a thrice-a-week routine. You may have to keep an eye on those cravings, and spruce up your diet. Do not take it as a punishment, says Ganesha. After all, precaution is always better than cure!. Shopping is on your mind today and you are in a mood to spruce up in order to catch the immediate attention of your sweetheart. Ganesha feels that you will eventually get support from his/her end and will get closer to your beloved. Regarding your health, the stars are very favourable. As a result, you shall be in a jolly good mood throughout the day. The output you churn out will be on the higher side – surprising one and all, says Ganesha. Ganesha feels that today you will tend to spend your money on improving your image. Try to control the desire to spend money on unnecessary creature comforts, and try to set aside some money for emergencies. Today, you will be highly creative and motivated. Therefore, use your skills effectively as it is likely to benefit you in your professional growth. You may also be promoted or given additional responsibility at work. Your intelligence and stamina will lead to superlative achievement for the company, feels Ganesha.

The day will bring unexpected changes and pleasant surprises. You may hit the road with your loved ones, and the journey will not only be exciting but also calm your nerves. Overall, a bright, happy day to make most of, says Ganesha. You are requested to avoid being overly possessive about your partner as this may lead to disagreement. You cannot impose burdens on your partner. Be ready to listen whatever he/she needs. A clear understanding between you and your sweetheart will smooth the path of relationship, feels Ganesha. Your fitness level may swing downwards on this dull day, says Ganesha. Hence, you need to give more priority to your health. Just avoid working beyond your limits, and think twice before reacting to irritating people and adverse circumstances. Today, Ganesha feels that you may burn a hole in your pocket, and it may take a long time to make up. Though your intention would be to stick to your budget, you will end up overspending. Hard work pays, but at times the payment may get delayed. Ganesha says that you should not lose heart if you don’t get an instant recognition or benefit for the efforts you have put in as patience reaps huge dividends in the long run.

It’s time to take what is already good, and turn it into something better. Take this day as a day to bring about improvements in your life and yourself. You may also consider taking up some extra courses in the evening. Maybe it’s time for a salsa lesson, or learn how to toss a few Italian delicacies. Small crash courses go a long way in enhancing your efficiency, says Ganesha. You have to comply with your beloved’s wish to attend a social function or a film. At the end of the day, you will be patting yourself on the back for making your partner happy. Your partner’s support and social recognition will strengthen your commitment to your lover. On this wonderful day, you shall get up feeling very high. With your mood swinging upwards, you will get along well with everyone in your workplace and home. Right time to get in touch with friends and relatives says Ganesha. Ganesha feels that today is a favourable day on the financial front for you. You would be able to generate good income from various quarters. Projects undertaken for government will be beneficial. The strong support from your seniors and your enthusiasm will boost your progress at the workplace. No delay is foreseen on the cards and things will get properly planned and managed. The overall positive atmosphere in the workplace will boost your morale and it will be long lasting.

You might just blow your fuse today, warns Ganesha. Anger will melt all sense and sensibilities. But if logic does prevail eventually, things may just improve as the day passes. Ganesha says it is high time you awakened your softer side. You seem to be inconsistent while spending time with your partner recently. You, however, need to get your love life a bit more established and should give your loved one more attention and warmth. A little bit of creativity and honesty will definitely excite you to strengthen your relationship. Regarding your health, the planets are on your side. Thus, you are going to overflow with energy and enthusiasm from morning till evening, observes Ganesha. Work that may be challenging for others, will appear to be easy for you today. Ganesha says that today is the ideal time to make rapid progress on the financial front. You shall get good projects from people in powerful positions. You will be able to increase your contacts base. Since you have been experienced with difficulties before and know how to handle the situation, you will be more prepared than ever to achieve your primary goals. Your focus, commitment, and determination will be well known and ultimately achieve better results for your concern.

A demanding day today, as you find yourself in charge of arranging and attending high-voltage meetings. Those dealing in stock and share will have profitable returns in the afternoon. But don’t count your chickens before they hatch, says Ganesha. Wait till the evening to count those wads of notes. You want to get faster responses from your loved one but it may not happen in the real life. You need to be practical, feels Ganesha. Therefore, keep patience and control and avoid giving false hopes to your partner, suggests Ganesha. In various spheres of your life, you are bound to taste success today, foretells Ganesha. Your positivity will be spread like wild fire in your surroundings, and people in your professional as well as social circle will thus react positively. Today you will be fortunate in case of financial matters, and therefore you will be willing to push your luck. You will not be averse to taking risks and will also wish to pump money into business. You will be constantly trying to motivate your colleagues at work. Your peers may rely on you. Ganesha, however, advises you to focus on your own work that needs utmost attention. Remember, a little mistake or error will put you in a great trouble, alerts Ganesha.

To many, you will seem to have got your senses back after a long time. Reason? You will finally have a definite career plan in mind. It’s not really a big deal, but considering that you Leos are always in two minds about everything, it’s quite an achievement, says Ganesha. Having a clear idea about what you exactly want from life will help you save a lot of your precious time, energy and money. You need to spend more time with your beloved as it will help you get your focus back. Discussing some interesting topics or engaging in creative activities will entice your lover to get closer to you and spend a wonderful night, suggests Ganesha. The less favourable planetary configuration of today will make you feel less energetic and less enthusiastic, says Ganesha. Just avoid physically and mentally challenging activities and take good care of your health. If required, take a half-day off, and relax. Ganesha feels that today looks like an average day on the financial front, so you must shun taking any major risks. But if you still do so, you are likely to suffer major financial losses. You are undertaking huge responsibilities and have to take an incredible amount of pressure, foresees Ganesha. You may have to work till late at night to fix a problem. It may deviate your focus from more important things and may even spoil your mood, feels Ganesha.

It’s family time, and your near and dear will be mighty pleased. You will pamper and fuss over them, and will even pull funny faces to make them smile. Your love and affection will undoubtedly pay off, and come back to you in more ways than one. Ganesha says you deserve a pat on the back for being so devoted to family. Current planetary transit says that you will be in a satisfied mood. It’s a good time to find some innovative ways to decorate your home or revamp domestic activities with your partner. If you are not interested, be ready to get tickled by your sweetheart who wants to sweeten your mood. The stars may be less supportive today, foretells Ganesha. As a result, you may get up from bed feeling low and lazy. Yet, you should try to remain composed. To improve your mood – do something interesting and exciting. Ganesha says that today is a very auspicious day for money matters. You will not be spending much, so things are likely to move smoothly for you on the financial front today. You should not strive for attention at work, advises Ganesha. Ganesha believes that if you keep up the good work that you have been doing, you will get your share of importance by your boss and colleagues. However, you need to take responsibilities for your mistakes.

You have been neglecting your health of late, a fact which is hammered home by your ill-fitting trousers today! So, while you ignored the adage of prevention being better than cure, you could still make a stitch in time to save nine! Head for the gym, and watch those calories, says Ganesha. You may feel bored with daily tasks and may want to spend quality time with your loved ones. You are in a mood to take your partner out for an exotic dinner. You are likely to spend the time alone with your soulmate to make him/her feel special and strengthen the relationship. For some reason or other, you are likely to remain tense today, foretells Ganesha. Certain issues in the personal or professional sphere may be the cause of concern. To overcome this adverse situation, avoid being emotional and think practically. Ganesha feels that today expenses are likely to blow up, but you will control things just in time, that is before it is too late. Expenses on routine necessities. will be as usual. Despite all the hard work, you may fall short of your goals. However, don’t let this disappoint you. Ganesha says that you need to maintain and rearrange your office routine. Work harder to achieve your goal and you will surely succeed, inspires Ganesha.
